description: Converting a tuple of null keywords to a list of any gives a list of the nulls
notes: The conversion gives a list whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type, the unification of the two nulls' types, which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Iterating over the list doesn't avoid that, since its elements, nulls of the dynamic pseudo-type, have the list's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result. hashicorp/hcl gives such a list (conversionTupleToList in go-cty's cty/convert/conversion_collection.go).
